facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 13 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Olallie Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 10 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
